name: pitaya-cooperative-lifecycle-cancellation-b131
instr:
Pitaya cannot run lifecycle work under cancellation and phase deadlines or report deterministic outcomes. Add cooperative contextual execution while preserving the existing lifecycle. Modules may implement `ContextModule` from `github.com/topfreegames/pitaya/v3/pkg/interfaces`; legacy modules remain supported.

Use distinct nonnegative budgets for initialization, post-initialization, pre-shutdown, and shutdown. Zero adds no deadline beyond the parent context. `LifecycleStatus`, `LifecyclePolicy`, `ModulePhaseResult`, and `LifecycleReport` from `github.com/topfreegames/pitaya/v3/pkg/lifecycle` report every attempted phase in registration order, including its error and completed, failed, cancelled, deadline-exceeded, or skipped status. Cancellation or failure stops forward work and starts reverse cleanup of initialized modules, preserving cleanup failures separately from the initiating outcome. Every lifecycle phase owned by `cluster.NewEtcdServiceDiscovery`, `cluster.NewGRPCClient`, `cluster.NewGRPCServer`, `cluster.NewNatsRPCClient`, and `cluster.NewNatsRPCServer` cooperatively honors its supplied context and budget while starting and maintaining connections, listeners, discovery work, subscriptions, retries, and drains, so cancellation or expiry stops phase-owned work, yields its phase result, starts no later forward work, and preserves any previously established usable transport state.
